name: Real
sum_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i) : ∑ i ∈ s, √(f i) * √(g i) ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} {f g : ι → ℝ} (s : Finset ι),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ f i) → (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ g i) → ∑ i ∈ s, √(f i) * √(g i) ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i)
result.value: := by simpa [*] using sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ (fun x ↦ √(f x)) (fun x ↦ √(g x))
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Sums of Square Roots of Non-Negative Functions
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ and non-negative real-valued functions $ f $ and $ g $ defined on $ s $, the inequality $ \sum_{i \in s} \sqrt{f(i)} \cdot \sqrt{g(i)} \leq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} f(i)} \cdot \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} g(i)} $ holds.

name: intervalIntegral
norm_integral_le_integral_norm
result.signature: (h : a ≤ b) : ‖∫ x in a..b, f x ∂μ‖ ≤ ∫ x in a..b, ‖f x‖ ∂μ
result.type:
∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → E}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ}, a ≤ b → ‖∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x ∂μ‖ ≤ ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, ‖f x‖ ∂μ
result.informal_name: Norm Inequality for Interval Integrals: $\| \int_a^b f \, d\mu \| \leq \int_a^b \|f\| \, d\mu$
result.informal_description: For real numbers $a \leq b$ and a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ valued in a normed space $E$, the norm of the interval integral of $f$ from $a$ to $b$ with respect to measure $\mu$ is bounded above by the integral of the norm of $f$ over the same interval. Symbolically, $\left\| \int_{a}^{b} f(x) \, d\mu(x) \right\| \leq \int_{a}^{b} \|f(x)\| \, d\mu(x)$.

name: abs_real_inner_le_norm
result.type: ∀ {F : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (x y : F), |inner ℝ x y| ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Real Inner Product Spaces
result.informal_description: For any vectors $x$ and $y$ in a real inner product space $F$, the absolute value of their inner product satisfies $|\langle x, y \rangle| \leq \|x\| \cdot \|y\|$.

name: real_inner_le_norm
result.type: ∀ {F : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (x y : F), inner ℝ x y ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Real Inner Products
result.informal_description: For any vectors $x$ and $y$ in a real inner product space $F$, the inner product $\langle x, y \rangle$ satisfies $\langle x, y \rangle \leq \|x\| \cdot \|y\|$.

name: real_inner_mul_inner_self_le
result.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (x y : F),
  inner ℝ x y * inner ℝ x y ≤ inner ℝ x x * inner ℝ y y
result.value:
:=
  calc
    ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ * ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ ≤ ‖⟪x, y⟫_ℝ‖ * ‖⟪y, x⟫_ℝ‖ :=
      by
      rw [real_inner_comm y, ← norm_mul]
      exact le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ⟪x, x⟫_ℝ * ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ := @inner_mul_inner_self_le ℝ _ _ _ _ x y
result.informal_description: For any vectors $x$ and $y$ in a real inner product space $F$, the square of their inner product satisfies $\langle x, y \rangle^2 \leq \langle x, x \rangle \langle y, y \rangle$.
